summary: The app is maximally conservative: it targets the current stable React Router major (8.5.x) and uses exclusively long-stable APIs (route config helpers, loader/data, Layout, Links/Meta/Scripts, useSearchParams/useNavigate). No experimental flags, unstable_ names, preview, or canary features appear anywhere in app/. Experimentalness risk is zero; if anything, the app deliberately avoids even recently-stabilized conveniences like typegen-typed Route.ComponentProps in favor of hand-typed loader returns.
